大卫与酒店的计划(David and the the hotel Plan): 一篇关于旅行出行的A2短文:大卫与本的经历和小计划。
Last Thursday, David and Ben went to the airport. David plays basketball with Ben every Thursday. David hopes to visit Paris one day. The perfume she wore smelled like fresh spring flowers.
They took many photos at the hotel. David bought a hat at the shop yesterday. The weather was windy that day. What's more, car rental includes basic insurance.

It takes twenty minutes to get to the airport by bike. David thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. David spent the weekend at the supermarket. Best of all, mr Wilton teaches history at our local school.
David learned a lot about art. David wrote about the day in the diary. The airport is one of the best places in the city.
